title: What If We Spotted a Killer Asteroid 10 Years Out?

scenes.text: What if we spotted a killer asteroid ten years early? We already know how to push it.
In 2022, NASA hit an asteroid moon with a car-sized spacecraft at fourteen thousand miles an hour.
Its orbit around its partner took eleven hours and fifty-five minutes.
Afterward it was thirty-two minutes shorter. The goal was seventy-three seconds. DART beat it twenty-five times over.
But that was a small push. A real threat needs it years in advance, so a tiny change grows into a miss.
The scary part is not the push. It's not seeing the rock in time. A new space telescope is being built to find them.

description:
What if an asteroid was headed for Earth and we saw it ten years early?
NASA's DART mission shortened an asteroid moon's orbit by thirty-two minutes. A small push, years ahead, is the plan.
